title: Successful login submission
description: Verify that a registered user can submit valid credentials.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; a valid confirmed account exists; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter USER1_EMAIL | 3. Enter USER1_PASSWORD | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: The login submission completes without a Maestro command failure.
notes: The authenticated destination is not currently asserted because the destination screen has not been defined.

title: Unconfirmed email warning

title: Invalid email validation

title: Reset-password link routing

title: Hide login password
